title: Current Drupal Coding Standards are on GitLab Pages
summary: The Drupal Coding Standards project links to the current GitLab Pages standards, while the historical Drupal.org coding standards guide is marked obsolete and deprecated; the current standards state that they are version-independent and always-current.

sources.locator: Read the Drupal Coding Standards / Obsolete and deprecated
sources.title: Coding Standards project

drupal_core.notes: The current standards describe themselves as version-independent and always-current.

actions: Use the GitLab Pages standards as the primary coding standards source.
Treat obsolete Drupal.org coding standards pages as provenance or redirect evidence only.
checks: Do not cite obsolete Drupal.org wiki standards as primary authority when the GitLab Pages standards cover the same rule.
automation_hints: Future coding-standard checks may map records to PHPCS, ESLint, Stylelint, or Twig tooling.

enforcement.rationale: The source provenance is reviewed; specific coding-standard failures need individual records and evidence.
